style: stylized dark-fantasy ARPG, 3/4 top-down friendly, slightly cartoon

referencePolicy.note: Reference image is never uploaded. Design is described in original words; differences are listed below.
differences: helmet: reference has tall winged crown; ours is a rounded dome with a low horizontal fin crest and no wings
neck/shoulders: reference has a white fur collar; ours has a plain metal gorget and large round sun-disk pauldrons
palette: reference is white-silver with gold; ours is gold-dominant with silver trim and navy cloth
emblem: sun-disk radial motif (original) instead of the reference's ornaments
weapon: one-handed leaf-blade broadsword with sun-disk pommel, not the reference's two-handed sword
lower body: reference has a long robe; ours is a short navy tabard above the knees plus a thin short cape that ends at the calf
proportions: about 7.5 heads, with a rounded dome helmet and rounded pauldrons instead of the reference silhouette

preview.prompt: Full-body dark-fantasy golden knight, realistic-stylized proportions about 7.5 heads tall, standing in A-pose, arms slightly away from the body, legs apart. Polished gold plate armor with silver trim. Rounded dome helmet with a narrow horizontal visor slit and a low fin crest, no wings, no horns. Large rounded shoulder pauldrons with a sun-disk emblem. Short thin cape attached to the shoulders, ends at calf height, hanging behind the back only, never touching the ground. Short navy tabard above the knees. Right hand firmly gripping a one-handed broadsword with a leaf-shaped blade and round sun-disk pommel, blade pointing downward beside the right leg, blade length half of the character height. Left hand empty. Clean silhouette, plain background.

refine.texture_prompt: Hand-painted stylized gold armor with silver trim, dark navy cloth, subtle scratches, warm highlights, no baked lighting

notes: v1 preview (4876 tris) rejected: floor-length cape, no sword, spiky pauldrons. Cost 20 credits.
User decisions on v1: 7.5-head proportions accepted; cape must end near the calf; sword must be present.
